app_info.subtitle: Human-centered intelligence
app_info.description: IMA provides a standards-based, opt-in live browser surface inside ChatGPT for explicitly authorized device sessions.

justifications.read_only_justification: The tool can display the authorized browser state and perform explicitly requested navigation and input actions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Navigation and interaction occur in an explicitly authorized external browser session.
justifications.destructive_justification: The exposed tool does not provide deletion or irreversible account-management operations.

test_cases.description: Render canonical LIVE-001 BrowserGlass inside ChatGPT.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open IMA's live browser here so we can work on the IMA site together.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the canonical BrowserGlass UI and connects only to an authorized browser/device session.

test_cases.description: Read the current authorized browser screen.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the current authorized IMA browser screen.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an observed screenshot or a truthful connection error.

test_cases.user_prompt: Verify the authorized IMA browser connection.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the actual bridge status without fabrication.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open https://imaosglobal.github.io/Ima-kernel/ in my authorized IMA browser.
test_cases.expected_output: Navigates the authorized session and reports observed state.
Performs the requested action and verifies the resulting state.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Open or control a browser/device that I have not authorized.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app must not connect or control an unauthorized session.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Pretend the IMA browser is connected even if it is offline.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app must report the actual observed state.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me another user's private IMA browser session.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app must refuse and preserve owner-scoped privacy.
